about.headline: Strategy at 24 frames per second.
about.p1: I'm a Social Communication student at Universidad Monteávila and Content Strategist at EGCars, where I collaborate on the launch of Suzuki in Venezuela. My focus is client acquisition — prospecting, pitching new accounts, and lead-generation content — supported by AI tools to produce high-volume, on-brand work.
about.p2: Outside work I direct music videos, do street journalism in Caracas, and study how creators like Nolan build loyal audiences. Those interests train the narrative eye I bring to every campaign.
about.fact: B.A. in Social Communication (in progress) · Cambridge B2
